display.purpose: Start screen title and round result headline only.

headline.purpose: Panel headings, run title, court card names; uppercase index face.

title.purpose: Sub-section headings, phase tabs, big primary button.

index-numeral.purpose: Every compared number: HP, level, Net stats, damage, cost, gold, probability; 1.5 to 3rem by card size.

index-label.purpose: Small printed labels on a card or row: LVL, Hand 1 / Hand 2 / Body, Turn N.

body.purpose: All reading text; ledes capped at 72ch.

body-small.purpose: Card meta, captions, fight calculation, memory evidence.

label.purpose: Stat pip labels, tags, kbd hints.

shadows.name: lift-1
shadows.purpose: Panels, court cards, brand mark, hovered item cards, result panels.

shadows.name: lift-2
shadows.purpose: Menu, dialogs, toasts, phone action bar.

shadows.name: fan-card
shadows.purpose: Stacked cards in the boss's hand.

shadows.name: fan-card-played
shadows.purpose: The played card in the boss's hand.

shadows.name: focus
shadows.purpose: Focus token on baize; the global focus-visible style is a 3px yellow outline at 2px offset, switched to court blue (#1f3c8c) inside card stock, dialogs and menus where yellow is only about 1.7:1.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All lifts, deals, meters and fan transforms.

motion.name: t-fast
motion.purpose: Hover lifts, button presses, border shifts.

motion.name: t-med
motion.purpose: Card deal-in (6px drop and fade), meter width, fan rearrangement, toasts.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All animation and transition durations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action that advances the loop (Begin round, Prepare next round).
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Begin round 3 <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>

components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: var(--stock, #f7f5f0); } .ds-chip { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3ccbd); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 700 0.875rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink-3, #6b675e); } .ds-chip.is-on { background: var(--ink, #141414); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f3c8c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: White field on stock; number inputs use tabular figures.

components.html: The Boss RemembersDuelWorkshop
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 60px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--baize-900, #0f2a20); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--baize-950, #0b2219); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-right: auto; color: var(--on-baize, #eef3ef); font: 800 1.35rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-mark { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 30px; height: 40px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--stock, #f7f5f0); color: var(--red, #c4122f); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(11 34 25 / 0.25), 0 2px 8px rgb(11 34 25 / 0.18); } .ds-nav { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--on-baize-2, #b9d0c2); font: 700 1rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav:hover { color: var(--on-baize, #eef3ef); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); } .ds-nav.is-current { color: var(--on-baize, #eef3ef); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 var(--yellow, #f0b323); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #f0b323); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Item Card
components.description: Armory card at the 168px module: printed inner frame, index-face cost, suit-pip modifiers.
components.css: .ds-table { padding: 24px; background: var(--stock, #f7f5f0); } .ds-item { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; width: 168px; min-height: 168px; padding: 12px; border: 1.5px solid var(--line, #d3ccbd); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #141414); text-align: left; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-item::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #141414); border-radius: 9px; opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; } .ds-item:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--ink-3, #6b675e); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(11 34 25 / 0.25), 0 2px 8px rgb(11 34 25 / 0.18); } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--blue, #1f3c8c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-item:active { border-color: var(--red, #c4122f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--red, #c4122f); transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-0.6deg); } .ds-item-cost { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 12px; font: 800 1.5rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; } .ds-item-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; padding-right: 44px; } .ds-item-family { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--ink-3, #6b675e); } .ds-mods { margin-top: auto; display: flex; gap: 8px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-mods span { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; }

components.html: Armory
components.css: .ds-felt-tabs { padding: 16px; background: var(--baize-700, #1e4b39); } .ds-phases { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-phase { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; background: var(--baize-800, #163a2c); color: var(--on-baize-2, #b9d0c2); font: 800 1.15rem 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-phase:hover:not(.is-on) { background: var(--baize-600, #285f49); color: var(--on-baize, #eef3ef); } .ds-phase.is-on { background: var(--stock, #f7f5f0); color: var(--ink, #141414); } .ds-phase:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow, #f0b323); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-phase-panel { padding: 24px; border-radius: 0 14px 14px 14px; background: var(--stock, #f7f5f0); color: var(--ink, #141414); font: 800 1.75rem 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: The Boss's Hand
components.description: Signature: the boss's equal plans fanned on baize; the played card upright, raised, ringed in yellow with its draw probability.
components.css: .ds-boss-hand { margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--baize-700, #1e4b39); color: var(--on-baize, #eef3ef); font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fan { position: relative; height: 210px; } .ds-fan-card { position: absolute; bottom: 6px; left: 50%; width: 132px; height: 184px; margin-left: -66px; padding: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--stock, #f7f5f0); color: var(--ink, #141414); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25), 0 8px 16px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2); transform: translateX(calc(var(--i) * 92px)) rotate(calc(var(--i) * 5deg)); transform-origin: 50% 130%; transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-fan-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5px; border: 1.5px solid var(--red, #c4122f); border-radius: 9px; opacity: 0.45; pointer-events: none; } .ds-fan-card.is-weaker { background: var(--stock-2, #eeeae1); color: var(--ink-2, #474540); filter: saturate(0.4); } .ds-fan-card.is-weaker::before { border-color: var(--ink-3, #6b675e); } .ds-fan-card.is-played { z-index: 3; transform: translateX(0) translateY(-18px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--yellow, #f0b323), 0 14px 28px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.38); } .ds-fan-index { font: 800 1.9rem/1 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; color: var(--red, #c4122f); } .ds-fan-index small { font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-fan-arch { font: 800 1rem 'Big Shoulders Display', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-fan-margin { margin-top: auto; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink-3, #6b675e); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-boss-hand figcaption { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--on-baize-2, #b9d0c2); } .ds-boss-hand figcaption b { color: var(--on-baize, #eef3ef); }

narrative.overview:
Every screen is a card table. The ground is deep green baize; every working surface is a sheet of off-white card stock laid on it; every item, fighter and plan is a playing card with rounded corners and a thin printed inner frame. Colour is printed, not lit: four flat court inks (red, blue, yellow, black) that appear only on card faces and on state. The shell itself is baize, stock and ink, so when red or blue appears it carries meaning (the boss, the player, a loss, a win).

Density is that of a working card game, not a dashboard: a grid of equal-sized item cards, two large face-up court cards for the fighters, and a fan of cards for the boss's plans. Numbers are read like card indices, in a tall condensed face, large and tabular; everything that has to be read as language is set in Atkinson Hyperlegible. Depth is the physical depth of cards on felt: soft green-tinted shadows, a lift on hover, a tilt when a card is picked.

The world explicitly refuses the dark-parchment RPG panel and the grey analytics dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Baize ground, card-stock panels, white card faces: three material layers, always in that order.
Four flat court inks; saturated colour only on card faces and state.
One card form (rounded corners plus a printed inner frame) used at three sizes: court card, item card, fan card.
Suit pips stand for stats everywhere: heart HP, spade STR, diamond DEF, club DEX, drawn as authored SVG.
Condensed uppercase index face for headings and numerals; hyperlegible sans for all reading text.
Blue is always the player, red is always the boss.

rules.name: The Printed Ink Rule
rules.body: Saturated red, blue and yellow appear only on card faces and on state. The shell (top bar, page ground, panel stock) is baize, stock and ink, never a court colour.

rules.name: The Two Sides Rule
rules.body: Blue is the player and red is the boss, everywhere: level numerals, damage, HP meters, fight-log sides, the record, result panels. Never swap them and never use either as decoration.

rules.name: The Felt Legibility Rule
rules.body: On baize, the court inks are replaced by their on-baize tints (on-baize-player, on-baize-boss) or by yellow; dark red or blue text never sits directly on felt.

rules.name: The Index Rule
rules.body: Every number a player compares (HP, stats, damage, cost, gold, probability) is set in the index face at a size larger than its label, with tabular figures. Sentences are never set in the index face.

rules.name: The Uppercase Index Rule
rules.body: Headings in the index face are uppercase with slight tracking (0.02 to 0.06em); Atkinson text is never uppercased except table header cells and the small fight-summary side labels.

rules.name: The Felt Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted toward baize and always blurred. A card lifts by moving up (2 to 4px, plus a slight tilt when selected), not by gaining a hard edge.

dos: Do put every working surface on card stock (stock, 14px corners, Lift 1) laid on baize; put individual items on white card faces laid on that stock.
Do keep blue for the player and red for the boss in every numeral, meter, log side and result.
Do give every card face the printed inner frame (1.5px, inset 5px, 45% opacity, in the owner's ink).
Do show stats with the authored SVG suit pips (heart HP, spade STR, diamond DEF, club DEX) with the text label alongside on first read.
Do set compared numbers in Big Shoulders Display 800 with tabular figures, larger than their labels.
Do size Armory-style grids from the 168px card module.
Do use the yellow 3px ring for focus and for "the one that was chosen".
donts: Don't colour the shell: no red, blue or yellow top bars, page grounds or panel fills (result panels and the played card are state, not shell).
Don't put court-red or court-blue text directly on baize; use the on-baize tints or yellow.
Don't use Unicode suit or icon glyphs; suits and icons are the authored SVG set.
Don't use hard offset or black block shadows; depth is soft, baize-tinted lift.
Don't set sentences in the index face or uppercase Atkinson body text.
Don't drift toward the dark-parchment RPG panel or the grey dashboard.
